unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.

One synthetic macOS ARM64 canary ran the exact executor with a locally built minimap2 2.31-r1302 binary; this is narrow tool-integration evidence, not formal exact-package agent runtime evaluation or a scientific benchmark.
The deterministic self-test uses a bounded fake executable to verify argv, fail-closed behavior, SAM reconciliation, and publication; it does not validate minimap2's scientific output.
The fake adapter verifies the integration contract only and is not an aligner.
Representative genomes, real sequencing reads, mapping accuracy, performance scaling, and human-expert review have not been evaluated.

Only plain single-end short genomic DNA input and exact minimap2 2.31-r1302 are in scope; paired-end, interleaved, RNA/splice, long-read, compressed, indexed-reference, and other-version behavior is unverified.
Other operating systems and architectures, including Windows create-new publication and executable semantics, have not been verified.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The exact intended local reference FASTA is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Which exact local FASTA is the intended reference for this run?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use the producer-approved reference file and bind the run to its SHA-256; never infer or substitute a reference build.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Single-end, short-read, genomic-DNA assay identity is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Are these plain single-end short genomic DNA reads rather than paired/interleaved, RNA/splice, or long reads?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Continue only with an explicit single-end short genomic DNA declaration; route every other assay or layout elsewhere.
